title: 4 mistakes couples make before the honeymoon

items.head: Booking flights before checking the visa
items.body: Check visa rules and processing time **first**. Then lock flights.

items.head: Passport expiring within 6 months
items.body: Many countries refuse entry. **Check both passports today.**

items.head: Packing 4 cities into 6 nights
items.body: It's a honeymoon, not a race. **Fewer places, more time.**

items.head: Skipping travel insurance
items.body: One delayed flight costs more than the policy.
